children: Boohoo Group needs to continue to improve its competitive position and service offering mainly outside the U.K., RBC Capital Markets' Richard Chamberlain and Manjari Dhar write in a note. While the U.K. clothing retailer shows solid growth, it still faces high competition from peers, they say. "NEXT and Amazon, and brands' willingness to work with Debenhams may be impacted by more extensive promotional activity," they add. Shares in Boohoo Group, which trades as Debenhams, are up 2% at 25 pence. (najat.kantouar@wsj.com)
